        Bu programı yapan arkadaşlara söylemek isterim ki, "Google Fotoğraflar" çok güzel ve severek kullanıyorum..
 yalnız sorun şu ki!

-ana menüde bulunan bir fotoğrafı,
yeni açtığımız klasöre 👉🏻EKLE'diğimizde

Buraya kadar normal..

sadece orada olsun, Ana menüde gözükmesin,

 yada en basit, benim gibi düşünenler için, 
"EKLE" butonun yanına, "TAŞI" butonu da olsun,..

kim ne yapmak isterse yapsın..



<⁉️ KÜÇÜK BİR DETAY DAHA, 
resim düzlemeye girdiğimizde, kalemle işaretiyle butonuyla✍🏻,
boyama, çizim yapma, işaretleme veya bir yazma olsa daha iyi olur⁉️.

Hello,

I'd like to say to the developers of this program that "Google Photos" is very nice and I use it with pleasure... but the problem is!

-When we ADD a photo from the main menu to a newly opened folder,

(I can't say move, because there's no such option unfortunately)

When we ADD, the photo appears on both sides!

Up to this point, it's normal...

When I delete one of the same photos from the main menu or the folder I opened, it's deleted from both sides...

If;

If possible, 🌟

- Where should we delete them from, leaving only one at a time?

Or,

What I think is best,⁉️

The photos we move into the newly created folder,
should only be there, not visible in the main menu.

Or, most simply, for those who think like me,

Let there be a "MOVE" button next to the "ADD" button...

So that anyone can do whatever they want...

<⁉️ ONE MORE SMALL DETAIL,

When we enter the image layout, it would be better if there was a pen and marker button✍🏻,
for coloring, drawing, marking, or writing⁉️.

Thank you, have a good day...😊🇨🇦👍🏻

When I need to delete photos, sometimes I have to delete same photos for several times, just because there are some blank white spaces left, that after reboot turns back into photos I deleted. Moreover, syncing between devices could be better, because every time I need to transfer video from my laptop and I use Google photos I just cannot download video, it just says try in few minutes, and sometimes it could take hours... And in that cases I have to upload my photos several times, just so that they appear in app, but then finally they all appear and I have to delete duplicated ones... So please, Google, update your app, so that it wasn't that laggy, because for me, person, that use photos app many times a day, sometimes it just gets annoying to use it, and I simply think about switching to alternatives....

raw_text: I really want to like the service, but I've using it for a few years now and the problems seem to only get worse. First, the app is very slow when creating albums from multiple pictures, even on a high end phone and when there aren't that many pictures. And when I try to share the album around 70% of the time I get an error and it asks me to try again later. Also, the app constantly stops syncing my pictures, and I have to clear the data and start everything again, which takes many hours. And I want to be able to choose my video quality, because right now it's either a hugely overcompressed file that is barely usable, or the original file which takes tons of space and is not very optimized. So I either waste time pre-processing the videos before uploading, or have to constantly throw money so that I can store my huge files. You own Youtube, I'm pretty sure you can have a better solution to handle videos. And there should be different options for compressed/original for photos and videos, because photo quality is acceptable but video is not.

raw_text: Ok, so you´ve got all the fancy new functions, photoalbums, Assistent and bla bla.. but it got too clever, too far, too automatic, too prone to human arbitration. The app doesn´t allow you to for example manually change order of photos.  Few really disturbing things:  1) Why the heck when you make an album (upload from PC, photos in the PC are put in PC from phone by cable) are the photos chaotically disordered? They are not in the order of how you took them, they are mixed.  Google Photos reads wrong data info of the photos from computer.. Not when created (took), but when last edited.   2) Even worse (!), you can´t manually change the order. You can just go from the oldest, of from the youngest. That´s the problem. The app (or Google, or developers of the app) thing, that they are smarter than you. So they ban the option to manually change order of any photos in any album. In the end, totally useless, anger producing.

Also, there is an issue with deleting files - it takes something like 5 minutes to delete 60MB of data. Why, may I ask?

raw_text:
You can use google photos with backup on (express settings) that will backup the photos and videos in SD(lower) quality but will save your google cloud storage.
I use google photos for backing up my photos and videos in express quality settings and it has only used about 4.2GB for about 10,000 media files backed up. You can backup some specific media files in standard or HD settings to maintain the quality of the backed up copy of the media file.
I also suffered from the same issue of yours and used teh express settings.
Alternatively, you can create another google account and backup some media folders to that account and others to your main account which would practically give you a plenty of 30GB(15+15) of storage for media files.
I hope this helps....

I HATE the Photos app, I want to uninstal it without losing my photos, so I searched YouTube to learn how to use it properly especially since the latest update, in particular how to get my photos out of it. 

The update means it now no longer has the 'restore' function. 

And it **doesn't** have unlimited storage: Google keeps telling me I'm running out of storage, apparently I've used up 15GB out of a total of 17GB, and unless I pay for extra storage (£1.99 a month) I will lose access once it's full! 

Also, I've noticed that if I delete a photo from my Photos library, it automatically deletes it from my Gallery as well, which to me is unacceptable!
